ei.title: A Parent Trap for Gifted Children
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: As the parent of a gifted child, you need to be aware of a certain common parent trap. Of course you are a proud parent, and you should be. While it is very easy to talk nonstop about your little genius and his or her remarkable behavior, this can be very stressful on your child. It is extremely important to limit your bragging behavior to your very close friends, or your parents. Gifted children feel pressured when their parents show them off too much. This behavior creates expectations that they may not be able to live up to, and also creates a false sense of self for your child. You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.

questions.passage: As the parent of a gifted child, you need to be aware of a certain common parent trap. Of course you are a proud parent, and you should be. While it is very easy to talk nonstop about your little genius and his or her remarkable behavior, this can be very stressful on your child. It is extremely important to limit your bragging behavior to your very close friends, or your parents. Gifted children feel pressured when their parents show them off too much. This behavior creates expectations that they may not be able to live up to, and also creates a false sense of self for your child. You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could <u>end up with</u> a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 end up with이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: end up with = 결국 ~을 갖게 되다/~한 상태로 끝나다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 처음부터 다시 시작하다: end up의 '결국 ~로 끝나다'와 무관

✅ ② 결국 ~한 상태가 되거나 ~을 갖게 되다: 'you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out'에서 결국 그런 아이를 갖게 될 수 있다는 의미 ←정답

❌ ③ ~을 완전히 피하다: 관용구의 의미와 반대

❌ ④ ~을 다른 사람에게 넘기다: 관용구와 무관
det.tip: end up with ~ = 결국 ~을 갖게 되다/~한 상태로 끝나다 (관용구)
